description: The map of Close Knit's data; call it first, and whenever you are unsure of a metric, path or category name. No arguments: a summary (themes with metric counts and 2-3 headline metrics, Census in one line, places in one line, the entity kinds). theme='crime' lists that theme's metrics: unit, levels, period, coverage (England or London only), better end, what each measures and is not (name the metric you use; say when it differs from the question). query='trees' finds metrics with ranked within, source, own-row levels and England and region refs, paths, place categories and brands by words. kind='place' lists place categories with counts and brands; kind='school' the school measures; kind='lsoa' (or msoa, lad, rgn, pc, uprn, sector) the sections and select paths of that kind; kind='custom' the place presets; kind='ranking' the saved rankings for query(saved:); kind='guide' the site's guide articles, read with get(ids: ['guide:crime']).

kind.description: [option] what to describe: metric (default), place categories, school measures, custom presets, saved rankings, guides, the guided questions, or an entity kind's sections and paths
kind.title: Kind

page.description: [paging] Page of a theme's metrics; next gives the following one.
page.title: Page

query.description: [search: contains] Any of the words, any case, in ids, labels, categories, brands and paths
query.title: Query
